propositions: A description edit verified at 14,997 chars was silently reverted to an older 10,582-char revision during concurrent in-flight plan-review, with no ConcurrencyError raised.
Optimistic concurrency control failed to reject a losing write; the write reported success and passed immediate read-back verification but was later discarded.
A REVIEW_RESULT sidecar event and a concurrent edit event caused store reconvergence, resulting in the newer edit being overwritten by stale client-held text.
The reducer cache race (fixed in 0b964c82f5) allowed old reducer generations to publish current event hashes with stale state, causing successful reads followed by stale reads.
Whole-field description EDIT events apply last-writer-wins without compare-and-swap, allowing stale unconditional replacements to clobber newer content.
The documented constraint against editing a ticket during its own review is undocumented and conflicts with the normal revise-then-review workflow prescribed by the plan-review gate.
